title: ADHD Therapy for Adults in Colorado | Rebuilding Together
desc: Therapy for adult ADHD in Colorado: late diagnosis, women, rejection sensitivity, masking and hormones. Neurodivergent-affirming, in person or online.
html:
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Marcellus&family=PT+Serif:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"><style>
#siteWrapper,#header,.header-announcement-bar-wrapper,#footer-sections,.sqs-cookie-banner-v2{display:none!important}
body{margin:0;background:#f6f0ea}
#rtc{position:relative;overflow-x:hidden}
#rtc h1,#rtc h2,#rtc h3{color:inherit;text-transform:none;font-weight:400}
#rtc .rt-hero h1{text-transform:uppercase}
#rtc p,#rtc li,#rtc dd,#rtc dt{color:inherit}
#rtc a{border:0}
#rtc .mnav{display:none;position:relative;margin-left:auto}
#rtc .mnav summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border:1px solid currentColor;padding:12px 16px}
#rtc .mnav summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
#rtc .mnav[open] summary{background:var(--cream);color:var(--plum)}
#rtc .mnav-panel{position:absolute;right:0;top:calc(100% + 8px);background:var(--cream);color:var(--plum);min-width:250px;padding:6px 0;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(42,16,35,.3);z-index:30;max-height:75vh;overflow:auto}
#rtc .mnav-panel a{display:block;padding:11px 20px;text-decoration:none;font-size:16px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(60,24,50,.12)}
#rtc .mnav-panel a:last-child{border-bottom:0}
#rtc .rt-top .rt-wrap{padding:18px clamp(18px,4vw,56px)!important}
@media (max-width:980px){#rtc .mnav{display:block}}
@media (max-width:640px){#rtc .rt-top .rt-pill{display:none}#rtc .rt-logo span{font-size:12px}#rtc .rt-logo img{width:48px;height:48px}}
#rtc .legal{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 24px;margin-top:28px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid rgba(60,24,50,.15);font-size:13px}
#rtc .legal a{margin-right:18px;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
#rtc{--plum:#3c1832;--plum-deep:#2a1023;--cream:#f6f0ea;--cream-2:#efe6dc;--sage:#6f7d6d;--sage-deep:#55634f;--clay:#7a6255;--rose:#c66d7a;--teal:#2f8c8a}
#rtc *{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
#rtc{margin:0;background:var(--cream);color:var(--plum);font-family:"PT Serif",Georgia,serif;font-size:17px;line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
#rtc a{color:inherit}
#rtc h1,#rtc h2,#rtc h3,#rtc .rt-m{font-family:"Marcellus",Georgia,serif;font-weight:400;margin:0;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:.01em}
#rtc img{display:block;max-width:100%}
#rtc .rt-wrap{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(18px,4vw,56px)}
#rtc .rt-top{position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto 0;z-index:5;color:var(--cream)}
#rtc .rt-top .rt-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:28px;padding:18px 0}
#rtc .rt-top nav{flex:0 0 auto;white-space:nowrap}
#rtc .rt-logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;text-decoration:none}
#rtc .rt-logo img{width:64px;height:64px;filter:invert(1) brightness(1.4)}
#rtc .rt-logo span{font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.25}
#rtc .rt-top nav{display:flex;gap:24px;font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
#rtc .rt-top nav a{text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid transparent}
#rtc .rt-top nav a:hover{border-color:currentColor}
#rtc .rt-pill{font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border:1px solid currentColor;padding:12px 18px;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap}
#rtc .rt-pill:hover{background:var(--cream);color:var(--plum)}
#rtc .rt-hero{position:relative;min-height:100svh;display:grid;align-items:end;color:var(--cream);overflow:hidden;background:var(--plum)}
#rtc .rt-hero img.rt-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 40%}
#rtc .rt-hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(42,16,35,.55) 0%,rgba(42,16,35,.15) 35%,rgba(42,16,35,.82) 75%,var(--plum) 100%)}
#rtc .rt-hero>.rt-wrap{position:relative;z-index:2;padding-bottom:64px;padding-top:160px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:8fr 4fr;gap:40px;align-items:end}
#rtc .rt-hero h1{font-size:clamp(40px,6.2vw,92px);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;max-width:12ch}
#rtc .rt-hero .rt-sub{font-size:clamp(17px,1.5vw,21px);max-width:44ch;margin:24px 0 0;color:#f3e6ea}
#rtc .rt-hero .rt-sub b{font-weight:400;color:#fff;font-family:"Marcellus",serif;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:14px;display:block;margin-bottom:10px}
#rtc .rt-hero .rt-side{border-left:1px solid rgba(246,240,234,.4);padding-left:24px;font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.9}
#rtc .rt-hero .rt-side a{color:#fff}
#rtc .rt-band{background:var(--cream-2);color:var(--plum)}
#rtc .rt-band .rt-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
#rtc .rt-band .rt-wrap>div{padding:26px 20px 26px 0;border-right:1px solid rgba(60,24,50,.18);font-size:15px}
#rtc .rt-band .rt-wrap>div+div{padding-left:20px}
#rtc .rt-band .rt-wrap>div:last-child{border-right:0}
#rtc .rt-band b{display:block;font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--clay);margin-bottom:4px}
#rtc .rt-amy{padding:96px 0;position:relative}
#rtc .rt-amy .rt-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:5fr 7fr;gap:0;align-items:center}
#rtc .rt-amy figure{margin:0;position:relative}
#rtc .rt-amy figure img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 20%}
#rtc .rt-amy figure:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-18px auto auto -18px;width:60%;height:60%;border:1px solid var(--sage);z-index:-1}
#rtc .rt-amy .rt-card{background:var(--cream-2);padding:clamp(28px,4vw,56px);margin-left:-48px;position:relative;border-left:6px solid var(--plum)}
#rtc .rt-amy h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.4vw,46px);margin-bottom:18px}
#rtc .rt-amy p{margin:0 0 16px;max-width:60ch}
#rtc .rt-amy .rt-sig{font-family:"Marcellus",serif;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:13px;color:var(--clay)}
#rtc .rt-what{background:var(--sage);color:var(--cream);padding:88px 0}
#rtc .rt-what .rt-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:4fr 8fr;gap:56px;align-items:start}
#rtc .rt-what h2{font-size:clamp(32px,3.6vw,50px);max-width:12ch}
#rtc .rt-what .rt-lead{color:#e4e9e1;max-width:34ch;margin:18px 0 0}
#rtc .rt-what ol{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;counter-reset:n}
#rtc .rt-what li{counter-increment:n;display:grid;grid-template-columns:48px 1fr auto;gap:18px;align-items:baseline;padding:20px 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(246,240,234,.3)}
#rtc .rt-what li:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(246,240,234,.3)}
#rtc .rt-what li:before{content:counter(n,decimal-leading-zero);font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#d9e0d5}
#rtc .rt-what li a{font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,26px);text-decoration:none;color:#fff}
#rtc .rt-what li a:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:5px}
#rtc .rt-what li small{font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#cdd6c8}
#rtc .rt-what li p{grid-column:2/-1;margin:4px 0 0;color:#e4e9e1;font-size:15.5px;max-width:58ch}
#rtc .rt-quote{position:relative;padding:120px 0;color:var(--cream);text-align:center;overflow:hidden;background:var(--plum)}
#rtc .rt-quote img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 70%;opacity:.55}
#rtc .rt-quote:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(42,16,35,.3),rgba(42,16,35,.85))}
#rtc .rt-quote .rt-wrap{position:relative;z-index:2}
#rtc .rt-quote h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,56px);max-width:22ch;margin:0 auto}
#rtc .rt-quote p{max-width:60ch;margin:22px auto 0;color:#f0e2e6;font-size:18px}
#rtc .rt-team{padding:96px 0}
#rtc .rt-team .rt-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:5fr 7fr;gap:40px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:40px}
#rtc .rt-team h2{font-size:clamp(32px,3.6vw,50px)}
#rtc .rt-team .rt-head p{margin:0;color:var(--clay);max-width:54ch}
#rtc .rt-roster{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:28px 24px}
#rtc .rt-roster a{text-decoration:none;display:block}
#rtc .rt-roster figure{margin:0}
#rtc .rt-roster img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;border-radius:999px 999px 0 0}
#rtc .rt-roster figcaption{padding:12px 0 0;border-top:1px solid var(--plum);margin-top:12px}
#rtc .rt-roster b{display:block;font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-weight:400;font-size:18px}
#rtc .rt-roster span{display:block;font-size:14px;color:var(--clay);margin-top:3px}
#rtc .rt-roster .rt-amyc img{object-position:center 15%}
#rtc .rt-roster .rt-more{display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid var(--plum);aspect-ratio:3/4;border-radius:999px 999px 0 0;font-family:"Marcellus",serif;text-align:center;padding:24px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.5}
#rtc .rt-where{background:var(--plum);color:var(--cream);padding:88px 0}
#rtc .rt-where .rt-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:5fr 7fr;gap:56px;align-items:start}
#rtc .rt-where h2{font-size:clamp(32px,3.6vw,50px);max-width:12ch}
#rtc .rt-where .rt-lead{color:#e8d6dc;max-width:34ch;margin:18px 0 0}
#rtc .rt-where dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:12px 28px;margin:0}
#rtc .rt-where dt{font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#d9b7c0;padding-top:4px}
#rtc .rt-where dd{margin:0}
#rtc .rt-where .rt-map{margin-top:28px;position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/8;background:var(--plum-deep);border:1px solid rgba(246,240,234,.25);overflow:hidden}
#rtc .rt-where .rt-map iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;display:block}
#rtc .rt-where .rt-map .rt-dir{position:absolute;right:0;top:0;background:var(--plum);color:var(--cream);text-decoration:none;font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:12px 16px}
#rtc .rt-where .rt-map .rt-dir:hover{background:var(--plum-deep)}
#rtc .rt-blog{padding:88px 0;background:var(--cream-2)}
#rtc .rt-blog .rt-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:5fr 7fr;gap:40px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:36px}
#rtc .rt-blog h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.4vw,46px)}
#rtc .rt-blog .rt-head p{margin:0;color:var(--clay);max-width:54ch}
#rtc .rt-posts{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:32px}
#rtc .rt-posts li{border-top:2px solid var(--plum);padding-top:16px}
#rtc .rt-posts a{font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-size:21px;text-decoration:none;display:block;margin-bottom:8px;line-height:1.25}
#rtc .rt-posts a:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:5px}
#rtc .rt-posts p{margin:0;color:var(--clay);font-size:15.5px}
#rtc .rt-cta{padding:96px 0}
#rtc .rt-cta .rt-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:7fr 5fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
#rtc .rt-cta h2{font-size:clamp(32px,4vw,58px)}
#rtc .rt-cta .rt-box{background:var(--plum);color:var(--cream);padding:34px}
#rtc .rt-cta .rt-box b{display:block;font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-weight:400;font-size:20px;margin-bottom:8px}
#rtc .rt-cta .rt-box p{margin:0 0 18px;color:#e8d6dc;font-size:15.5px}
#rtc .rt-cta .rt-box .rt-pill{color:var(--cream)}
#rtc .rt-cta .rt-box .rt-pill:hover{background:var(--cream);color:var(--plum)}
#rtc .rt-strip{height:14px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--plum),var(--clay),var(--sage),var(--rose),var(--teal))}
#rtc footer{padding:40px 0 48px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--clay)}
#rtc footer .rt-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:32px}
#rtc footer b{color:var(--plum);display:block;margin-bottom:8px;font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:12.5px}
#rtc footer ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
#rtc footer li{margin:4px 0}
#rtc footer a{text-decoration:none}
#rtc footer a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
@media (max-width:980px){#rtc .rt-hero>.rt-wrap,#rtc .rt-amy .rt-wrap,#rtc .rt-what .rt-wrap,#rtc .rt-where .rt-wrap,#rtc .rt-cta .rt-wrap,#rtc .rt-team .rt-head,#rtc .rt-blog .rt-head,#rtc footer .rt-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:28px}
#rtc .rt-hero .rt-side{border-left:0;padding-left:0}
#rtc .rt-amy .rt-card{margin:-40px 16px 0}
#rtc .rt-roster{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
#rtc .rt-posts{grid-template-columns:1fr}
#rtc .rt-band .rt-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
#rtc .rt-band .rt-wrap>div:nth-child(2){border-right:0}
#rtc .rt-band .rt-wrap>div:nth-child(3){padding-left:0}
#rtc .rt-top nav{display:none}}
#rtc{--gold:#d9a441;--teal-deep:#174f4e;--rose-soft:#f3dcdc;--ink:#2a1023}
#rtc .ax-lt .rt-top{color:var(--plum)}
#rtc .ax-lt .rt-logo img{filter:none}
#rtc .ax-lt .rt-pill:hover{background:var(--plum);color:var(--cream)}
#rtc .ax-k{font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 14px}
#rtc .ax-k a{text-decoration:none}
#rtc .ax-p{max-width:62ch}
#rtc .ax-p p{margin:0 0 16px}
#rtc .ax-p a,#rtc .ax-ul a{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}
#rtc .ax-sec{padding:clamp(64px,8vw,112px) 0}
#rtc .ax-h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,52px);margin:0 0 22px}
#rtc .ax-arch{border-radius:999px 999px 0 0;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4}
#rtc .ax-tl{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:5px;font-family:"Marcellus",serif;letter-spacing:.04em}
#rtc .ax-faq dt{font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-size:clamp(19px,1.8vw,23px);margin:0 0 8px}
#rtc .ax-faq dd{margin:0 0 30px;max-width:56ch}
#rtc .ax-faq dd a{color:inherit;text-decoration:underline}
#rtc .adhd-hero{background:var(--plum);color:var(--cream);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
#rtc .adhd-hero>.rt-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:6fr 6fr;gap:40px;align-items:center;padding-top:150px;padding-bottom:80px;min-height:78svh}
#rtc .adhd-hero h1{font-size:clamp(40px,5.6vw,84px);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;max-width:10ch}
#rtc .adhd-hero .ax-sub{font-size:clamp(17px,1.5vw,20px);max-width:44ch;margin:22px 0 0;color:#ecdbe0}
#rtc .tags{position:relative;min-height:420px}
#rtc .tags span{position:absolute;font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-size:clamp(17px,1.9vw,26px);padding:12px 18px;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--ink)}
#rtc .tags span s{text-decoration-color:var(--plum);text-decoration-thickness:3px}
#rtc .tags .t1{top:4%;left:6%;background:var(--rose);transform:rotate(-4deg)}
#rtc .tags .t2{top:22%;left:44%;background:var(--gold);transform:rotate(3deg)}
#rtc .tags .t3{top:42%;left:2%;background:#8fc7c1;transform:rotate(2deg)}
#rtc .tags .t4{top:58%;left:38%;background:var(--cream);transform:rotate(-3deg)}
#rtc .tags .t5{top:76%;left:10%;background:#c9b6d9;transform:rotate(-1deg)}
#rtc .tags .t6{bottom:-2%;right:2%;background:none;color:var(--gold);font-size:clamp(22px,2.6vw,36px);padding:0;transform:none}
#rtc .adhd-intro .rt-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:5fr 6fr;gap:64px;align-items:start}
#rtc .adhd-intro .big{font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-size:clamp(26px,2.8vw,40px);line-height:1.2;margin:0}
#rtc .adhd-work{background:var(--cream-2)}
#rtc .adhd-work ol{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;column-gap:64px;counter-reset:n}
#rtc .adhd-work li{counter-increment:n;border-top:1px solid rgba(60,24,50,.2);padding:22px 0 26px 64px;position:relative}
#rtc .adhd-work li:before{content:counter(n,decimal-leading-zero);position:absolute;left:0;top:22px;font-family:"Marcellus",serif;color:var(--rose);font-size:24px}
#rtc .adhd-work li b{display:block;font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-weight:400;font-size:21px;margin-bottom:6px}
#rtc .adhd-not{background:var(--sage);color:var(--cream)}
#rtc .adhd-not .rt-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:7fr 5fr;gap:56px;align-items:end}
#rtc .adhd-not h2{font-size:clamp(32px,4.4vw,64px);line-height:1.08}
#rtc .adhd-not h2 em{font-style:normal;color:#f2d38f}
#rtc .adhd-not p{color:#e7ece4;margin:0 0 14px}
#rtc .who4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:28px;margin-top:36px}
#rtc .who4 a{text-decoration:none}
#rtc .who4 b{display:block;font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-weight:400;font-size:19px;margin:14px 0 4px}
#rtc .who4 span{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--clay);line-height:1.5;display:block}
#rtc .adhd-end .rt-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:6fr 5fr;gap:64px}
#rtc .adhd-read a{display:block;font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,27px);line-height:1.3;padding:18px 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(60,24,50,.2);text-decoration:none}
#rtc .adhd-read a:hover{color:var(--rose)}
#rtc .adhd-read a:after{content:" \2192"}
#rtc .emdr-hero{background:var(--teal-deep);color:var(--cream)}
#rtc .emdr-hero>.rt-wrap{padding-top:170px;padding-bottom:60px}
#rtc .emdr-hero h1{font-size:clamp(46px,8vw,128px);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
#rtc .emdr-hero .ax-sub{font-size:clamp(17px,1.5vw,21px);max-width:50ch;margin:20px 0 0;color:#d9ebe9}
#rtc .bls{position:relative;height:40px;margin:56px 0 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(246,240,234,.35)}
#rtc .bls i{position:absolute;top:-9px;left:0;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);animation:bls 2.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
#rtc .bls small{position:absolute;top:16px;font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#b9d6d3}
#rtc .bls small.r{right:0}
@keyframes bls{from{left:0}to{left:calc(100% - 18px)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#rtc .bls i{animation:none;left:calc(50% - 9px)}}
#rtc .emdr-what .rt-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:5fr 6fr;gap:64px;align-items:start}
#rtc .acro{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
#rtc .acro li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:88px 1fr;align-items:baseline;border-top:1px solid rgba(60,24,50,.2);padding:10px 0}
#rtc .acro li b{font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-weight:400;font-size:64px;line-height:1;color:var(--teal)}
#rtc .acro li span{font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,28px)}
#rtc .phases{background:var(--cream-2)}
#rtc .phases ol{list-style:none;margin:40px 0 0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(8,1fr);border-top:2px solid var(--plum)}
#rtc .phases li{padding:18px 16px 0 0;position:relative}
#rtc .phases li:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-7px;left:0;width:12px;height:12px;background:var(--plum)}
#rtc .phases li.hot:before{background:var(--gold);width:14px;height:14px;top:-8px}
#rtc .phases li em{font-style:normal;font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--clay)}
#rtc .phases li b{display:block;font-family:"Marcellus",serif;font-weight:400;font-size:18px;line-height:1.2;margin:6px 0}
#rtc .phases li span{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.5;display:block}

 <div><p class="ax-k"><a href="/">Home</a> / ADHD therapy</p><h1>ADHD therapy for adults.</h1>
 <p class="ax-sub">For adults who were told they were too much, not trying hard enough, or just anxious, and later found out it was ADHD. Or are starting to wonder.</p></div>
 <div class="tags" aria-hidden="true"><span class="t1"><s>too much</s></span><span class="t2"><s>lazy</s></span><span class="t3"><s>careless with details</s></span><span class="t4"><s>just anxious</s></span><span class="t5"><s>not living up to your potential</s></span><span class="t6">It was ADHD.</span></div>
</div></header>
<section class="adhd-intro ax-sec"><div class="rt-wrap">
 <p class="big">A lot of adults, especially women and AFAB folks, get diagnosed in their 30s or 40s. Often right after one of their kids is.</p>
 <div class="ax-p"><p>Before that, it gets called anxiety, depression or a personality flaw. Many people spent years masking: over-preparing, people-pleasing and running on stress to keep up. It works, until it doesn't.</p><p>Finding out can bring relief and grief at the same time. Both make sense, and both are things we can work with.</p></div>
</div></section>
<section class="adhd-work ax-sec"><div class="rt-wrap">
 <p class="ax-k">What we work on</p><h2 class="ax-h2">The stuff under the to-do list.</h2>
 <ol>
  <li><b>A late diagnosis</b>Making sense of it, including the grief for the years before.</li>
  <li><b>Rejection sensitivity</b>The sting that hits before anyone has said anything, and the emotional intensity around it.</li>
  <li><b>Shame</b>From years of being called lazy, careless or dramatic.</li>
  <li><b>Hormones</b>How the menstrual cycle, pregnancy and perimenopause change symptoms.</li>
  <li><b>Relationships and parenting</b>ADHD at home, with a partner, and with kids who may have it too.</li>
  <li><b>The overlap</b>Where ADHD meets autism, anxiety and trauma.</li>
 </ol>
</div></section>
<section class="adhd-not ax-sec"><div class="rt-wrap">
 <h2>Not forcing your brain into a system built for <em>someone else.</em></h2>
 <div><p>Therapy here is about understanding how you work, dropping the shame, and building routines and boundaries that fit your actual life.</p><p>Some of our therapists bring in IFS or EMDR when old hurts are part of the picture.</p></div>
</div></section>
<section class="ax-sec"><div class="rt-wrap">
 <p class="ax-k">Who to see</p><h2 class="ax-h2">Therapists who work with ADHD.</h2>
 <div class="who4"><a href="https://rebuildingtogethercounseling.com/amy-moreno"><img class="ax-arch" src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/64c7ea91c7c5e43cd2ef5be9/5e5ff668-6995-4dd6-9d84-3a77153b36e1/IMG_2343.jpg?format=750w" alt="Amy Moreno" loading="lazy"><b>Amy Moreno, LPC</b><span>ADHD in women, later-in-life diagnosis. Telehealth.</span></a><a href="https://rebuildingtogethercounseling.com/tiffany-sersen"><img class="ax-arch" src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/64c7ea91c7c5e43cd2ef5be9/2c01b503-4277-4a81-a2bd-098e0951a183/May9-3-3.jpg?format=750w" alt="Tiffany Sersen" loading="lazy"><b>Tiffany Sersen, MSW</b><span>ADHD, autism and burnout. Colorado Springs + telehealth.</span></a><a href="https://rebuildingtogethercounseling.com/tatianna-saunders"><img class="ax-arch" src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/64c7ea91c7c5e43cd2ef5be9/479b70f7-eac3-4be3-bb29-63d3520231b6/Tatianna+Headshot.jpg?format=750w" alt="Tatianna Saunders" loading="lazy"><b>Tatianna Saunders, LPCC</b><span>Neurodivergent adults and creatives. Boulder + telehealth.</span></a><a href="https://rebuildingtogethercounseling.com/emma-lewallen"><img class="ax-arch" src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/64c7ea91c7c5e43cd2ef5be9/9cce879b-bad1-47b0-ae3e-25373700a4e8/emma+website.jpeg?format=750w" alt="Emma Lewallen" loading="lazy"><b>Emma Lewallen, MFTC</b><span>ADHD and autism in kids, teens and families. LoHi + telehealth.</span></a></div>
</div></section>
<section class="adhd-end ax-sec" style="padding-top:0"><div class="rt-wrap">
 <div><p class="ax-k">Common questions</p><dl class="ax-faq"><dt>Do I need a diagnosis to start?</dt><dd>No. Plenty of people start therapy because they suspect ADHD. If you want a formal evaluation, we can talk about where to get one.</dd><dt>Do you prescribe medication?</dt><dd>No. Our therapists are counselors, not prescribers. We're happy to work alongside your doctor or psychiatric provider.</dd><dt>Is online therapy okay for ADHD?</dt><dd>For many people it's easier. No commute, fewer missed appointments, and you can be somewhere comfortable.</dd></dl></div>
 <div class="adhd-read"><p class="ax-k">Read first, if you like</p>
  <a href="https://rebuildingtogethercounseling.com/traumainformed-therapy-blog/adhd-in-women-why-its-often-missed-or-misdiagnosed">Why ADHD in women gets missed or misdiagnosed</a>
  <a href="https://rebuildingtogethercounseling.com/traumainformed-therapy-blog/rejection-sensitivity-and-adhd-why-your-brain-braces-before-it-breaks">Rejection sensitivity and ADHD: why your brain braces before it breaks</a></div>
</div></section>

<div class="rt-wrap"><p class="ax-k"><a href="/">Home</a> / EMDR</p>
 <h1>EMDR therapy.</h1>
 <p class="ax-sub">A structured way to help your brain reprocess painful memories so they stop running the show. Without having to retell every detail.</p>
 <div class="bls" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><small>Left</small><small class="r">Right</small></div>
</div></header>
<section class="emdr-what ax-sec"><div class="rt-wrap">
 <div><p class="ax-k">What it is</p><ul class="acro"><li><b>E</b><span>Eye</span></li><li><b>M</b><span>Movement</span></li><li><b>D</b><span>Desensitization and</span></li><li><b>R</b><span>Reprocessing</span></li></ul></div>
 <div class="ax-p"><p>EMDR helps the brain reprocess painful or overwhelming memories so they no longer feel as triggering. The memory stays. The alarm attached to it gets quieter.</p><p>It can reduce symptoms of PTSD, anxiety and depression, and help you feel calmer and more in control of how you react.</p><p>The back and forth part, eye movements, tapping or tones, is called bilateral stimulation. It's only one piece of the process.</p></div>
</div></section>
<section class="phases ax-sec"><div class="rt-wrap">
 <p class="ax-k">What sessions look like</p><h2 class="ax-h2">Eight phases. You set the pace.</h2>
 <ol><li><em>01</em><b>History</b><span>What brings you in, and what we will focus on.</span></li><li><em>02</em><b>Preparation</b><span>Skills to calm your body, so you have a way back.</span></li><li><em>03</em><b>Assessment</b><span>Choosing one memory and noticing what comes with it.</span></li><li class=hot><em>04</em><b>Reprocessing</b><span>Short sets of eye movements or tapping while you notice.</span></li><li><em>05</em><b>Installation</b><span>Strengthening a belief about yourself that fits better.</span></li><li><em>06</em><b>Body scan</b><span>Checking for anything still held in the body.</span></li><li><em>07</em><b>Closure</b><span>Ending each session settled, whether or not the memory is done.</span></li><li><em>08</em><b>Re-evaluation</b><span>Looking at what changed since last time.</span></li></ol>
 <p class="note">Early sessions are mostly about history, safety and skills. Reprocessing starts when you're ready, and you can pause at any point. You don't have to describe everything out loud.</p>
</div></section>
<section class="ax-sec"><div class="rt-wrap">
 <p class="ax-k">Who it tends to help</p>
 <p class="slash">PTSD and complex trauma <i>/</i> anxiety and panic <i>/</i> grief and loss <i>/</i> childhood experiences that still shape how you react <i>/</i> medical and birth trauma</p>
</div></section>
<section class="emdr-pair ax-sec" style="padding-top:0"><div class="rt-wrap">
 <div class="ax-p"><p class="ax-k">EMDR with IFS</p><h2 class="ax-h2">Two tools, one plan.</h2><p>Some of our therapists combine EMDR with Internal Family Systems. EMDR lowers the charge on a memory, and IFS supports the parts of you that have been carrying it.</p><p>Read about <a href="/ifs-brainspotting">IFS and Brainspotting</a>, or Amy's post on <a href="https://rebuildingtogethercounseling.com/traumainformed-therapy-blog/the-magic-of-emdr">the magic of EMDR</a>.</p></div>
 <div><p class="ax-k">EMDR clinicians on the team</p><a class="clin" href="https://rebuildingtogethercounseling.com/amy-moreno"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/64c7ea91c7c5e43cd2ef5be9/5e5ff668-6995-4dd6-9d84-3a77153b36e1/IMG_2343.jpg?format=750w" alt="Amy Moreno" loading="lazy"><div><b>Amy Moreno, LPC</b><span>EMDR Certified. IFS-informed EMDR. Telehealth.</span></div></a><a class="clin" href="https://rebuildingtogethercounseling.com/tiffany-sersen"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/64c7ea91c7c5e43cd2ef5be9/2c01b503-4277-4a81-a2bd-098e0951a183/May9-3-3.jpg?format=750w" alt="Tiffany Sersen" loading="lazy"><div><b>Tiffany Sersen, MSW</b><span>Somatic EMDR. Colorado Springs + telehealth.</span></div></a><a class="clin" href="https://rebuildingtogethercounseling.com/kelsey-loupy"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/64c7ea91c7c5e43cd2ef5be9/da1ce753-1465-4bc5-beab-929b2fd73c32/2026_Kelsey28_02+headshot+2.jpeg?format=750w" alt="Kelsey Loupy" loading="lazy"><div><b>Kelsey Loupy, PhD, LPCC</b><span>EMDR trained. Boulder + telehealth.</span></div></a></div>
</div></section>
<section class="emdr-faq ax-sec"><div class="rt-wrap"><h2 class="ax-h2">Common questions</h2><dl class="ax-faq"><dt>Does EMDR work over video?</dt><dd>Yes. Many clients find online EMDR just as effective as in-person sessions, with the bonus of being at home afterward.</dd><dt>How many sessions does it take?</dt><dd>It depends on what you're working on. A single recent event can move quickly. Complex or childhood trauma takes longer. Your therapist will talk this through with you.</dd><dt>Will I have to relive the trauma?</dt><dd>No. EMDR doesn't require going through every detail. You stay in the present while the memory is processed.</dd></dl></div></section>

 <div><p class="ax-k"><a href="/">Home</a> / IFS and Brainspotting</p><h1>IFS and Brainspotting.</h1>
 <p class="ax-sub">For people who want to go underneath the story. Parts work and brain-body approaches, for when talking about it hasn't been enough.</p></div>
 <svg viewBox="0 0 520 470" role="img" aria-label="Parts gathered around a calm center">
<circle cx="170" cy="150" r="118" fill="#c66d7a" opacity=".55"/>
<circle cx="350" cy="150" r="118" fill="#d9a441" opacity=".55"/>

<text x="260" y="242" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:20px">Self</text>
<text x="100" y="104">the planner</text><text x="352" y="104">the critic</text>
<text x="62" y="390">the one who</text><text x="62" y="410">shuts down</text><text x="360" y="396">the little one</text>
</svg>
</div></header>
<section class="duo ax-sec"><div class="rt-wrap">
 <div class="col"><h2>Internal Family Systems</h2><p class="tag">Parts work</p>
  <h3>The idea</h3><p>We all have different parts. Some carry pain, some protect us, some try to keep everything under control.</p>
  <h3>In session</h3><p>Instead of fighting the critical or anxious parts, you get curious about them and find out what they're protecting. That opens room for healing and for your own steady sense of Self.</p>
  <h3>A good fit if</h3><p>You're hard on yourself, you feel pulled in two directions, or you can explain your patterns perfectly and they still don't change.</p></div>
 <div class="col"><h2>Brainspotting</h2><p class="tag">Brain and body</p>
  <h3>The idea</h3><p>Where you look affects how you feel. Specific eye positions can connect to emotional and physical experience stored below words.</p>
  <h3>In session</h3><p>Your therapist helps you find a spot that holds activation, then you stay with it while your brain and body do the processing. There is less talking than you might expect.</p>
  <h3>A good fit if</h3><p>Words feel like too little, or years of talk therapy haven't reached the root.</p></div>
</div></section>
<section class="parts ax-sec"><div class="rt-wrap">
 <p class="ax-k" style="color:var(--gold)">Parts you might recognize</p><h2 class="ax-h2">Every one of them is trying to help.</h2>
 <div class="grid"><figure><blockquote>“If I get this perfect, nobody can criticize me.”</blockquote><figcaption>A manager part</figcaption></figure><figure><blockquote>“Don't need anything. Needing things gets you hurt.”</blockquote><figcaption>A protector</figcaption></figure><figure><blockquote>“Just keep scrolling. Don't feel it.”</blockquote><figcaption>A firefighter part</figcaption></figure><figure><blockquote>“Something is wrong with me.”</blockquote><figcaption>An exile</figcaption></figure></div>
 <p class="after">In IFS, none of these parts are the enemy. They took on a job a long time ago. Therapy helps them put it down.</p>
</div></section>

 <ul><li>Complex trauma and C-PTSD</li><li>Anxiety, panic and burnout</li><li>Harsh self-criticism and perfectionism</li><li>Relationship patterns and attachment wounds</li><li>Feeling stuck after other therapy</li></ul>
</div></section>

 <h1>Perinatal and postpartum therapy.</h1>
 <p class="ax-sub">Trying to conceive, pregnant, grieving a loss, or in the blur of the first year. Support for the parts nobody warned you about.</p>
</div></header>
<section class="stages ax-sec"><div class="rt-wrap">
 <div class="lede"><p class="ax-k">What we help with</p><h2 class="ax-h2">Every stage has its own hard.</h2><p class="ax-p">Wherever you are right now, you can start there.</p></div>
 <ol><li><b>Trying to conceive</b><p>The waiting, the tracking, the appointments. Hope and dread in the same week.</p></li><li><b>Pregnancy</b><p>Anxiety and intrusive thoughts, old trauma waking up, and a lot of pressure to feel only grateful.</p></li><li><b>Loss</b><p>Miscarriage, stillbirth, a pregnancy ended for medical reasons. Grief that often goes unspoken.</p></li><li><b>Birth</b><p>Births that didn't go the way you planned, including ones that felt frightening or out of your control.</p></li><li><b>The first year</b><p>Postpartum depression and rage, sleep you never get back, a relationship under strain, going back to work or not.</p></li></ol>
</div></section>
<section class="notfail ax-sec"><div class="rt-wrap">
 <h2>You're not failing. This is a lot.</h2>
 <p>The perinatal years can bring up old anxiety, old trauma and identity shifts nobody talks about. Therapy is a place to say the hard stuff out loud without being judged for it.</p>
</div></section>
<section class="feat ax-sec"><div class="rt-wrap">
 <img class="main" src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/64c7ea91c7c5e43cd2ef5be9/f8fffaad-296a-4300-88b2-43285bb398c1/May21-33.jpg?format=750w" alt="Camryn Joseph" loading="lazy">
 <div class="ax-p"><p class="ax-k">Who to see</p><h2 class="ax-h2">Camryn Joseph, LPCC</h2>
  <p>Camryn focuses on perinatal mental health, from pre-conception through postpartum, along with anxiety, depression and life transitions. She uses IFS and nature-based approaches.</p>
  <p>In person in Golden, or online from your couch with a baby asleep on you.</p>
  <p><a class="ax-tl" href="https://rebuildingtogethercounseling.com/camryn-joseph">Read Camryn's bio</a></p>
  <a class="also" href="https://rebuildingtogethercounseling.com/emma-lewallen"><img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/64c7ea91c7c5e43cd2ef5be9/9cce879b-bad1-47b0-ae3e-25373700a4e8/emma+website.jpeg?format=750w" alt="Emma Lewallen" loading="lazy"><div><b>Emma Lewallen, MFTC</b><span>Postpartum, parents and families. LoHi + telehealth.</span></div></a>
 </div>
</div></section>
<section class="two-faq ax-sec"><div class="rt-wrap">
 <div class="ax-p"><p class="ax-k">How it works</p><p>Sessions can be in person in Golden or LoHi, or by video anywhere in Colorado. Our therapists use IFS, nature-based approaches and other trauma-informed methods, and they'll go at the pace your sleep allows.</p></div>
 <dl class="ax-faq"><dt>Can I bring my baby to sessions?</dt><dd>Ask your therapist. Telehealth makes this easy, and many parents attend with a little one nearby.</dd><dt>Is this only for birthing parents?</dt><dd>No. Partners and adoptive parents are welcome too.</dd></dl>
</div></section>
<section class="end2 ax-sec"><div class="rt-wrap"><h2>One call. Fifteen minutes. Baby on your lap is fine.</h2><div class="row2"><a class="rt-pill" href="https://rebuildingtogethercounseling.com/consultation">Book a free 15 min consult</a><span>or call or text <a href="tel:+13033511307">303-351-1307</a></span></div></div></section>

 <div class="grid">
  <div><h3>Kids</h3><p class="rng">Ages 7 to 12</p><p>Play, drawing and talking, depending on the kid. Big feelings, worry, school trouble and friendship stuff.</p><ul><li>Anxiety and big feelings</li><li>ADHD and autism</li><li>Divorce and new family setups</li></ul></div>
  <div><h3>Teens</h3><p class="rng">13 to 18</p><p>A space that's actually theirs. Teens get real privacy, which is often what makes therapy work.</p><ul><li>Anxiety and depression</li><li>Identity, including LGBTQIA+ teens</li><li>School stress and social pressure</li></ul></div>

 <article><h2 id="what-this-covers">What this covers</h2><p>This policy covers rebuildingtogethercounseling.com. Your health information as a client is covered separately by the Notice of Privacy Practices you receive at intake, which follows HIPAA.</p><h2 id="what-the-site-collects">What the site collects</h2><p>When you use a contact form or book a consult, we collect what you enter, such as your name, email, phone number and message.
